scope:
Matched native-label10 disk fits with the actual falling-edge ALTCLKCTRL.

Both variants expose every original I/O, use50MHz,2ns/0ns virtual I/O and
identical fitter policy. All setup/hold paths stay timed; no false paths.
Only the18-bit cache-tag phase staging differs. No assembly or deployment.
expected_top:
module snapshot_fit(
 input wire extra_ready,
 input wire clk_sys,
 input wire reset,
 input wire attached,
 input wire readonly,
 input wire remounted,
 input wire [11:0] tagbus_n,
 input wire cyltag_n,
 input wire headtag_n,
 input wire drivetag_n,
 input wire conttag_n,
 input wire selected,
 input wire data_adv,
 input wire [15:0] pulse,
 input wire write_data_p,
 input wire write_data_m,
 output wire data_bit,
 output wire write_gate,
 output wire endofcyl_n,
 output wire ready,
 output wire dirty,
 output wire fault,
 output wire [2:0] host_phase,
 output wire [31:0] fault_debug,
 output wire [31:0] fault_extra,
 output wire [31:0] sd_lba,
 output wire [5:0] sd_blk_cnt,
 output wire sd_rd,
 output wire sd_wr,
 input wire sd_ack,
 input wire [12:0] sd_buff_addr,
 input wire [15:0] sd_buff_dout,
 input wire sd_buff_wr,
 output wire [15:0] sd_buff_din,
 output wire [31:0] reads,
 output wire [31:0] writes);
 wire guest_clock;
 altclkctrl #(.clock_type("Global Clock"),.ena_register_mode("falling edge"),.intended_device_family("Cyclone V")) machine_clock(
 .inclk({3'b000,clk_sys}),.clkselect(2'b00),.ena(!reset && ready && extra_ready),.outclk(guest_clock));
 dorado_pack_hps #(.LABEL_WORDS(10),.HOST_CLOCK_HZ(50000000)) u_medium(
.clk_sys(clk_sys),
.machine_clk(guest_clock),
.reset(reset),
.attached(attached),
.readonly(readonly),
.remounted(remounted),
.tagbus_n(tagbus_n),
.cyltag_n(cyltag_n),
.headtag_n(headtag_n),
.drivetag_n(drivetag_n),
.conttag_n(conttag_n),
.selected(selected),
.data_adv(data_adv),
.pulse(pulse),
.write_data_p(write_data_p),
.write_data_m(write_data_m),
.data_bit(data_bit),
.write_gate(write_gate),
.endofcyl_n(endofcyl_n),
.ready(ready),
.dirty(dirty),
.fault(fault),
.host_phase(host_phase),
.fault_debug(fault_debug),
.fault_extra(fault_extra),
.sd_lba(sd_lba),
.sd_blk_cnt(sd_blk_cnt),
.sd_rd(sd_rd),
.sd_wr(sd_wr),
.sd_ack(sd_ack),
.sd_buff_addr(sd_buff_addr),
.sd_buff_dout(sd_buff_dout),
.sd_buff_wr(sd_buff_wr),
.sd_buff_din(sd_buff_din),
.reads(reads),
.writes(writes));
endmodule
expected_sdc:
create_clock -name host_clock -period 20.000 [get_ports clk_sys]
derive_clock_uncertainty
set_input_delay -clock host_clock -max 2.000 [remove_from_collection [all_inputs] [get_ports clk_sys]]
set_input_delay -clock host_clock -min 0.000 [remove_from_collection [all_inputs] [get_ports clk_sys]]
set_output_delay -clock host_clock -max 2.000 [all_outputs]
set_output_delay -clock host_clock -min 0.000 [all_outputs]
